name: obsidian-anchor-jump
description: Obsidian plugin: copy a link that jumps to the exact spot you selected, and expose a small API for other plugins.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2020 --external:obsidian --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.js && cp manifest.json styles.css dist/

author: Kenta Ninomiya
